scope: Stable modifier-owned property contribution slots: set/refresh updates the slot value, removal deletes exactly that slot, observable property value is base plus ordered sum of contributions. Final stat materialization formulas remain PRIM-DAMAGE/stat packets.

evidence.support: E4 local evidence for contribution add/update/remove ownership and stable source slots across refresh/remove.
StackProperty/SetModifierValue/ModifySkillPropertyByType families are classified and structurally bound.

selected_model.slot_identity: contribution slot = (modifier identity, property name); refreshing updates that slot and never shifts neighbouring slots.
selected_model.observable_read: property = base + sum(contribution slots for that property) in deterministic slot order.
selected_model.removal: removing a modifier deletes only its own slots and returns the removed values; missing removal is an explicit no-op transition.

unsupported_cases: final stat fold semantics and property-kind formulas
acceptance_fixture: tests/game_data/test_property_contribution_reference.py proves stable slots, refresh, exact removal and missing-removal behavior.
dsh_implementation_contract: Represent contributions as an immutable slot map; never flatten contributions into a final base value, and never reorder or merge slots.
